runtime: Node.js >=20.19 discovered only at trusted host installation locations; existing local Node 22.15.0 verified
configuration: native_host_config.executable() automatically supplies integrator-owned NativeCircuitHost; never accept paths from player data
compile: C/C++ source editing and compiled HEX/BIN import supported; in-game arbitrary source compilation unavailable because compiler filesystem isolation is not implemented. Trusted Arduino fixture independently compiled and executed in tests.
spi_i2c: Disconnected controllers return 0xff/NACK; no physical bus slave/wire behavior claimed
uart: Peripheral byte endpoint, not serial wire edges
pico: Single core, raw flash vector startup. No bootROM, MicroPython, USB or blanket Pico SDK compatibility
electrical: GPIO edges and ADC reference tested; integrator retains sole ownership of electrical barrier/replay and board renderer
licenses: Existing vendored avr8js/rp2040js MIT license files preserved; no new third-party runtime or compiler redistribution
